name: John Stawinski
biography: John is an offensive security engineer, vulnerability researcher, and writer, specializing in Red Team operations and CICD security. John established himself as a member of the broader security community in 2023 through a series of CI/CD attacks on prominent open-source repositories. Embracing a nomadic lifestyle, John thrives on adventure sports and welcomes new experiences.
